title: Appointment of Director-General and Other Officers

content.scenario: The Central Government needs to establish a team to investigate consumer complaints under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. They are looking to appoint a Director-General and other officers to lead the team.
content.outcome: The Central Government must appoint a Director-General and other officers, such as Additional Director-General, Director, Joint Director, Deputy Director, and Assistant Director, from amongst persons with experience in investigation and possessing prescribed qualifications, in the manner prescribed.

user_queries: What are the qualifications required for the Director-General and other officers?
How are the Director-General and other officers appointed?
What is the role of the Director-General and other officers in investigating consumer complaints?
